response.sql: WITH player_totals AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total_games FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), average_total AS (SELECT AVG(total_games) AS value FROM player_totals) SELECT SUM(pt.total_games) AS sum_of_totals, AVG(pt.total_games - av.value) AS average_excess FROM player_totals AS pt CROSS JOIN average_total AS av WHERE pt.total_games > av.value
